scope: Local Chromium software GPU in the managed cloud, phone viewport 390×844 CSS pixels, DPR1. The normal viewer chooses its existing .6 render scale. Not a physical phone measurement.

capture.pixels: Original completed local WebGL canvas screenshots. Comparison PNGs use only uniform scale and labels.

phone.method: Unmodified normal anim.html playback at speed 1. A second RAF callback waits for gl.finish on the viewer draw and records real RAF intervals and wall time; it does not draw an extra scene or replace the viewer loop.
